decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The development hereby approved shall not be implemented until the exisiting, unauthorised, canopy structure the garage/shed structure beyond it and any associated part of the means of enclosure on the northern boundary of the site that is above 2m high shall shall be demolished and the resulting debries removed from the site.
description: Demolition of the existing conservatory and two garages and erection of single storey rear extension and part single storey side extension to house.
